decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated the options based on battery life, sound quality reviews, and water resistance for portability. The JBL Charge 5 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_120) stood out with a very high 4.8 rating, 20 hours of playtime, and the modern IP67 rating. While the Harman Kardon and B&O speakers offered premium audiophile sound, the Charge 5 provides a better balance of price and durable outdoor performance. I also considered the renewed JBL Flip 5 and Charge 4 for value, but preferred the newer technology and higher rating of the Charge 5.
